traps: all, test, install and clean are .PHONY: commands, not build units
the units are the file targets $(APP) and $(LIB); their names exist only after expanding the variables to build/mini and build/libmini.a
the library's sources are named by a pattern rule build/%.o: lib/%.c plus the OBJS list: no line lists lib/vec.c by name
the include directory and the definition come from CFLAGS and CPPFLAGS shared by every rule, not from a per-target setting
CC ?= cc and CFLAGS ?= -O2 are defaults the environment overrides; the += lines are always appended
-lm is a system library (libm), not a dependency to download
there is no other manifest: no configure, no CMake, no pkg-config file
both targets are declared by the one Makefile at the root, so both units have root . ; their sources live in lib/ and app/
